svg.aria-label: Read path: commit records fold into a snapshot; queries resolve the snapshot and read segments
svg.text: commit records (one per data object) | snapshot HEAD + parts | derived
catalog objects: column statistics (.cstat), name postings (.npost)
catalog fold (background, per tenant and signal)
lists sealed commit records, folds them into
snapshot parts, publishes HEAD by CAS;
losing the CAS is ordinary, never corruption
one GET of HEAD pins one immutable snapshot;
the whole query runs against that snapshot,
so a concurrent fold never changes its answer
time window and shard bounds from the snapshot; skip indexes, bloom
filters, and exact column statistics prune objects and blocks; a prune
may only ever widen the read set, never narrow it below correctness
footer probe, then ranged or whole-object GETs; a read cache holds hot chunks
SQL: samples, logs, spans (/api/v1/sql, Flight SQL)
